testPlan.title: Issue 26: undo of a name that a vehicle drives to

test.title: The game loaded this build
test.hint: Ticks itself: the running build is the one this plan was packed with.

test.title: A vehicle is driving to a waypoint you named
test.hint: Name a waypoint in the editor (that makes a marker), then send a vehicle to that name with AutoDrive. Click pass when it is driving there.

test.title: Undo the name: the vehicle's current destination moves to a marker that still exists
test.passLog: current destination was a marker the undo removed
test.hint: Undo the name. Ticks itself from the log.

test.title: The vehicle finishes its old run and stops at the old point
test.hint: Watch the vehicle reach the point the name was on. It should stop there, with no swerve, and not head on to Main Farm. Click pass if it does. Its next trip should start from Main Farm.
